segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: And Mr. Chair, mas advanced pa po.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: In fact, sir, kung matandaan po ninyo, nung nagkaroon ako ng crackdown sa mga smuggled na sports car,

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: madali namin nalolocate, sir, sa LTMS at hindi kasi nakakapasok, sir, sa LTMS.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: So isang dahilan yun, sir, na and also sa mga OFW po natin,

segments.text: nari-renew ko ho yung mga driver's license nila abroad.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Hindi kagaya ho ng Stratcom, sir.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Na wala silang mga ganong facility or ganong sistema para mas mapadali po ang pagsiservisyo po natin sa mga tao.

segments.text: Itong Dermalog is a German company?

Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Na ang kanyang specialization is biometrics?

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Yes, sir. Marami ho silang mga clients abroad, especially in Malaysia.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Naging maayos naman po ang kanilang mga…

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So merong proof of concept, in other words.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Yung LTMS, sir, so far, kaya very vocal po ako dyan.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: In fact, mas naging advanced tayo, lalo na sa ating mga driver's license at yung mga registration ng sasakyan.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Nawawala po yung mga… wala sa ayos.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Especially po yung mga Chinese driver's license na locate po namin through LTMS, biometrics.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Chinese driver's license, what is that?

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Before kasi, sir, alam naman po…

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Yes, sir. Before, nakakita naman natin nung very active po si, sir, nung time ng Pogo, si General Cruz.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Si Gilbert nag-crackdown ng Pogo, eh.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Yes, sir. Marami ho kaming nakita na through LTMS kasi, sir, yung biometrics, yung last operation po namin, na-determine namin na yung Filipino name, e meron Chinese pala siya.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: So kasi ang ginawa nila dati, sir.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Chinese talaga yung kumukuha. Ngayon nung ito na, ang ginawa nila, nagpalit sila ng Filipino name. Pero doon sa biometrics, nakita po namin through LTMS.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Okay. Okay. Paano itong… Last question, Mr. Chairman. Paano itong… Kasi tinitignan ko sa news. Paano itong mga… There's an effort to refund the 13 billion?

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I don't know if kasama kayo, but I read in the news na may mga groups na nagpa-file ng cases to get the refund

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Yes, sir. Kasi nga, yun po yung mahabang panahon na it was charged for the P169, sir. So ngayon, sir, nasa ano naman po natin, legality, atin sa humingi po kami ng tulong sa DOTR para po mas maayayos po natin yung tungkol po dyan.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And they're trying to refund P28 billion.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Hindi ko po masagot ngayon yan, sir. Pero pinatitingnan po namin yung legality at saka kung paano po.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Hindi ko rin alam bakit po sa mahabang panahon kasi naganyan yung mga kababayan natin.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: So kawawa po. Sa totoo lang, mabigat po talaga yung P169. Nakala kasi sa iba magaan pero sa masa, mabigat po yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But pag sinuma mo yan, biro mo P3 billion a year.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: That's the exact cost of the system na binili nyo.

LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: And mas maayos pa po yung sistema, sir.

segments.text: So yung additional request, Asec, for the maintenance and yung pag-setup ng inyong recovery disaster, how much is that?

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: The total amount, sir, is P4.2 billion, sir.

LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: And our confidential funds for P50.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: That's additional fund for the whole agency?

Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Pero yun doon po sa kailangan nyo lang na maintenance and yung pag-setup ng recovery system?

LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Yun pong disaster recovery center for existing LTMS is P2.7, P2.699.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: O totally ano lang yun? Database na na total?

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: And for the maintenance support service, P161 million.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Doon naman po sa hardware refresh of the existing LTMS na primary data center.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Kasi ito po yung hindi rin talaga pinondohan ng mahabang panahon as P1.3 billion po, sir.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Is there, kasi medyo malalaki rin ito, you know, for the fact that alam ng ating Senate President being the former Finance Chair that our fiscal space rate right now is really limited.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Can you give, submit to us yung talagang...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Bare minimum, para po dito, so that yung masimulan na yung kanina, yung disaster recovery, yung sa maintenance, yung yung refresh, hindi naman siguro kaya ito in one, kailangan ito in one year, all of this amount because this is quite big.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So siguro for this year, ano lang yung kailangan para lang masimulan natin so that, you know, at least hindi tayo matakot na in case there is a breakdown or calamity, at least nandun yung ating pong records.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
segments.text: Yes, sir. Mr. Chair, mag-send po kami. Pero yun nga po, yun po yung aming nire-request sana, pero mag-adjust po kami kung ano po yung mga papwede na.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Pero ano lang yan, as pointed out by our Senate President, it's, yung P3 billion is just one year for the former service provider.

segments.speaker: LTO Assistant Secretary Markus V. Lacanilao
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: No? So, but we'll see. Kasi medyo masigit talaga yung ano natin yung fiscal space. Okay?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, we can move on. Siguro I'll just have a couple of questions from, for the Secretary and the other agencies.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Dun po sa ano, no? Sa DOTR proposed 898.499 billion for right-of-way acquisition for 2027. But the NEP provides only 2.79 billion, a reduction of about 97.17% from the Department's proposal.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Right-of-way has been a perennial problem not only for the DOTR, but across government agencies like DPWH. And it has repeatedly contributed to delays in major infrastructure projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, ang question, what will be the impact of this substantial reduction on the implementation timelines of your major transportation projects? In particular, of course, yung ating NECR and Metro Manila Subway, more specifically, and also which project...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: What other projects require right-of-way funding in 2027, no? But receive no allocation under the NEP. Sige, hasik.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Simulan ko po, Mr. Chairman, dito sa ating RILES po, no?

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Tulad ng sinabi ko kanina, kahit may GOP tayo, kung saan pwede natin siguro kumuha ng tingi-tingi sa right-of-way, yan po yung nakalaan.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Dapat sa mga VAT natin at mga iba pang mga obligasyon.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Pagdating naman dito sa N1 at sa...

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: N2 po natin, yung para sa partial operations natin, wala po tayong masyadong issue dyan pagdating sa right-of-way.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Pero kapag bababa na po tayo, papunta naman dito sa sinasabi nating North-South, no?

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Yun po yung may kailangan pa kaming gastusin para bilhin ng mga lupain.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Sapagkat kapag if we don't get the right-of-way as of now po, matitinga po yung mananalong contractor.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Habang natitinga yung ating mga civil works, tumataas po ang ating gastusin.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Babayad na naman tayo ng prolongation cost.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Nasa rail pa lang po tayo.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Ganun din po ang sitwasyon natin sa ating mga paliparan.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kung maalala nyo po, Mr. Chairman, Mr. Senate President,

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: ang pulisiya po natin ngayon, pabaan na at palaparan yung ating mga runway.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Andami pa rin po tayong runway na para lang sa propeller.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Mas lalo na dun sa masinasabi nating mga tourist destination.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Case in point po, yung Siargao natin.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Napakatagal na po nating problema yung runway sa Siargao.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: And because of the physical configuration of the area itself.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: And for a time, hindi natin alam kung pupunta tayo dun sa mangrove

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: o pupunta tayo dito sa sinasabi nating other side of the runway

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: So, nakahanapan na po yan ang solusyon ng mga dalubasan.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kaya na po natin, sa ka-up ng mga technical experts natin,

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: kaya na po natin na pahabahin at palaparin ang ating runway sa Siargao

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: dito na po sa may mountainside area po.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Pero ang computation po natin dyan, kakailanganin natin na

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: hindi bababa po sa 500 million na right-of-way.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kasi as of now, ang ano lang po natin is 1 for I think

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: ang ating Siargao, more or less magano.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: It's not only the additional 500 meters na bibilin natin po.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Hindi po ganun kasimple pagdating sa runway.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Hindi lang po yung area na yun.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kaya lang mo pa kunin yung mga nasa tabi.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kasi sa strip grade correction, safety issues po.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kung gagamitin naman natin ang corporate,

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Mauubos na rin po ang pondo ng KAAP

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: madami pa rin po tayong right-of-way

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: ng ating mga Senate and Congress

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: na for a time din po kasi matagal

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: para sa right-of-way ng subway, ay maaari po na yung ilan po doon sa ating mga tunneling activities po ay mapahinto

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: dahil po wala po tayong pambayad doon po sa maapektuhan natin na landowner po.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: For the record, how long already yung ating diggings, yung tunneling natin?

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Ang tapos na po natin ay nasa 7.5 kilometers po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: How long does it take to complete yung buong tunneling of the 33 kilometers?

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang target po natin na full operations ay in 2031.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Ito po kasing tunneling natin ay nag-uumpisa po siya sa iba't ibang istasyon.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Patungo po doon sa sunod na istasyon.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: So iba-iba po yung timing nung umpisa po ng tunneling natin.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Pero on average po, ang nakikita po natin na actual progress ng mga tunnel boring machines natin,

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: meron po tayong labing siyam para po sa subway, ay nasa 5 to 12 meters per day, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: it receives one of the largest allocations for the entire right-of-way,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: also for the entire DOTR budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But yung ating right-of-way request was reduced from 23.89 billion to 2.79 billion.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Is the remaining right-of-way allocation sufficient to support the construction schedule funded under the 2027 budget?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Considering the next year, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Matay, tumakbo na sana ito by December 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And also, full blast na rin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: As I understand, nag-increase na rin yung inyong utilization and all,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: at saka yung sa ating construction.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: What will be affected from 23 billion naging 2.79 billion sa right-of-way?

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Mr. Chair, doon po sa ating partial...

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Partial operations po para next year.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Okay na po tayo na po.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Okay na po tayo na po natin yung right-of-way.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Nakatayo na po ang Civil Works.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Para po doon sa 28 kilometers, 7 stations po na Valenzuela to Malolos.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Siguro question na, just to add before you answer.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: What percentage of the total right-of-way of the NECR has already been acquired?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And which specific segments remain problematic?

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Mr. Chair, overall po yung buong North-South Commuter Rail ay nasa 78% po na right-of-way.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Yun pong N1 segment natin, yung sa gitna po, ay nasa 99% na po tayo.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: So, ito po yung kasama po yung magbubukas po next year.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Yun pong N2 segment, yung North-South segment po natin papuntang Clark, ay nasa 86% po tayo.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Kailangan po po natin ng mga 2 billion para po doon sa papuntang Clark.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: At doon po sa South natin, yung mula po Maynila papuntang Calamba, ay nasa 64% pa lang po tayo.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: upon the guidance po of our Secretary, yung South po, we need to make a critical decision po in the next few months.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: Dahil sa kasalukuyan po, ay nauubusan na po ng workable, na right-of-way, workable site,

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: ang aming mga contractors doon po sa South.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: So, kung hindi po kami makakakuha ng dagdag na budget, at nasa more than 20 billion po ang kailangan namin para sa South,

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: yung potential po na gagawin namin ay magpa-demobilize na po ng mga contractors sa South

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: para po mabawasan yung exposure natin sa prolongation cost, standby cost, at iba pong delay-related cost.

segments.speaker: DOTr Undersecretary Timothy John Batan
segments.text: So, that will be the effect kung hindi natin ma-prioritize yung right-of-way acquisition.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chairman, Your Honors. Yun po yung sinasabi natin ngayon na kapag wala talaga pondo, we have to minimize and cut our losses.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: No, nakatingga po mo ngayon, wala na nga tayo.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: So, hindi lang po yun, Mr. Chairman, habang matagal po tayo ng pagpo-pondo ng right-of-way, tataas yung presyo eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Meron pang inflation, may dollar depreciation pa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I think when we computed this first time, nasa 40 plus lang yung dollar peso ngayon.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: So, kesa naman matingga po at dumagdag pa yung gastusin ng gobyerno, pati utang.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: So, sabi nga po namin with rail, we have to make a very critical decision.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kung walang right-of-way, partial demobilize ka na lang para you won't charge us with prolongation cost.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: How much is the, yun lang ulit bare minimum, yun sa south na yan, para at least hindi tayo, we don't necessarily have to demobilize.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: So, we're going to identify certain areas na sa tingin namin kailangang mas bibigyan prioridad.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: At yun lang na naman po ang susumiti namin.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: We're not going to ask for the entire po.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: So, we're going to identify certain areas po.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Parang I think yung mas madali na right-of-way, isa sa mga pag-usapan namin, Santa Mesa and Paco.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: So, may mga areas po gano'n na titignan po namin.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Para yun lang po yung ingin namin ng budget po.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kasi maaari mag-cut loss tayo ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But later on, tataas na presyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Mamaya magkaroon ng depreciation na naman, inflation, etc.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At least, andito ang Senate President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We'll try to figure a way on how to prevent this.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: In the future, we will end up spending more.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Senate President, that the amount we're going to ask

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: is not unreasonable, but realistic po.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kasi hindi rin naman tayo, ano yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.text: Lalo yung sa West Philippine Sea?

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: Sir Chairman, Sir, there are still eight stations in need of funding.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, West Philippine Sea, di ba?

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: It will, it will, yes, His Excellency, Palawan area and KIG.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: And obviously, it will have a very significant impact to our activities in the West Philippine Sea.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Does any update sa media? May patanong, may update ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Anong update sa pagbangga ng Chinese vessel sa Bifar vessel? Kanina umaga ba ito?

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: Yes, at 11.15 today, one Chinese Coast Guard vessel rammed a Bifar vessel.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Anong circumstances? May nasaktan ba sa atin?

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: Well, there are no personnel injuries.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: They're very, ano ito, aggressive na.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: A Philippine Coast Guard vessel is now proceeding to the area to assist.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: And they also dispatched an aircraft to the area.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Hindi naman, ano, na-disabled ba yung, ano, yung Bifar vessel?

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: Actually, Your Honor, yesterday, we also assisted the same vessel, the same Bifar vessel.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: He decided to proceed with the mission of giving fuel subsidies to the fishermen.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: Meron po tayong tinatawag natin kadiwa para sa mga bagong bayaning manging isda or KBBM,

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: where the Coast Guard and Bifar gives fuel subsidies, ice, water, and goodies to fishermen to encourage them to fish offshore.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: May action ba tayo sa ganitong mga incidents sa West Philippine Sea?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Pag merong ganitong intimidation sa Bifar, sa mga fishermen, what does the Coast Guard take action?

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: For one, we already issued the press release.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: We have been banking on information as our strongest, the most potent weapon in this kind of game we're in.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: So, we have released the PR already.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: We are informing the world that China has behaved this way again.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Saka ano na to, talagang they're still becoming very, very hostile and aggressive na itong they rammed our Bifar vessel.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: We have to remember that Bifar vessel is manned by civilian sailors, actually.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: It's just there to distribute support to our fishermen.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: So, it is very unfortunate to see a public vessel treated like that by China Coast Guard.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Talagang this is really a disrespect to our sovereignty.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And wala nang respeto talaga, eh, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Do you report this to the DFA para magsulat ng diplomatic protest?

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: We are part of the National Task Force on the West Philippine Sea and DFA is part of it.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Considering the 57.5% cut to our capital outlays and the 3.3 billion reduction in air,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and floating asset acquisition and maintenance,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: How will the PCG maintain adequate sea-based patrols in the critical areas like West Philippine Sea?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, 3.3 billion pa na ang reduction natin from the NEP for the acquisition of air and floating assets.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: It will significantly compromise our operational ability, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: The repair and maintenance requirement of our ships is already at the, you know,

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: So, we are really appealing to the Senate to consider our budgetary request.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: We have to remember, Your Honor, that we only have so much ships.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: So, the time between overhaul is very, very short.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: It's just a matter of time that we will run out of ships.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: We are trying to prevent that.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Do we have any vessel expected to be coming?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I think yung mga binring up ni Senator Zubiri,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: President Zubiri before, yung naglagay tayo ng 2.5 billion na hindi na tuloy.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: What's the status of these vessels?

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: Yun pong 2.5 billion na hindi po natuloy yung nung 2024-25.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: So, we are now pursuing the procurement process for the local construction of 160-meter vessel.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: But on top of that, we are...

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: And 40-35 meter fast patrol crafts from France.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: But this will happen at the soonest next year, yung maliliit.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: So, sa ngayon po, Your Honor, we have to make good with what we have.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: That's why we really need very, very badly

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, itong drop in sea-based patrol funding under the Maritime Security Law Enforcement Program,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: it will really impact yung PCG's daily operational response, no?

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: It's the minimum that we need.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: So, kung babawasan pa po, we will be constrained.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: It was cut down by 812 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ano po yung bare minimum para naman at least yung presence sa atin ay nandun,

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: I can't give you the numbers now, Your Honor, but we can give it back to you.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yes, please submit yung talagang ano.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Pasensya na, talagang masikip ang ating space ngayon,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: kaya lahat ang hinihingi ko sa lahat ng agencies now is bare minimum.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: If I may, Your Honor, take advantage of this opportunity.

segments.speaker: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil L. Gavan
segments.text: We also submitted a supplemental request.
